instruction: extract.py uses a regex to pull key=value pairs from input.txt, but it drops keys containing underscores and values with dots. Fix the regex so all pairs extract, then run it: expected pairs.txt has 4 lines.
setup:
printf 'user_name=ann
port=8080
host=db.local
timeout=30
' > input.txt
cat > extract.py <<'EOF'
import re
pairs = re.findall(r'([a-z]+)=(\w+)', open('input.txt').read())
open('pairs.txt','w').write('
'.join(f'{k}={v}' for k,v in pairs) + '
')
EOF

oracle.script:
cat > extract.py <<'EOF'
import re
pairs = re.findall(r'([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(\S+)', open('input.txt').read())
open('pairs.txt','w').write('\n'.join(f'{k}={v}' for k,v in pairs) + '\n')
EOF
python3 extract.py
